verdict.rationale: Sumsub exposes RESTful APIs and webhooks that return applicant status, rejection reasons, and next steps (sumsub-docs-40), plus configurable AML/risk screening and anomaly detection signals that can drive automated branching (sumsub-docs-6, sumsub-docs-24, sumsub-docs-37). Webhooks deliver machine-readable event notifications for status changes usable by automated onboarding flows (sumsub-docs-3, sumsub-docs-28), and an MCP server is documented to let agents perform operations programmatically (sumsub-docs-4, sumsub-probe-3). missing for 10: no published OpenAPI/schema spec was found (sumsub-probe-2 shows 404s), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of structured risk-signal payload completeness.
